name: DVET ITI Apprenticeship — Fitter Trade (Pune District)
department: Directorate of Vocational Education & Training, Maharashtra
description: Apprenticeship placement in manufacturing and engineering firms for ITI Fitter trade pass-outs under the Apprentices Act, 1961.
eligibility_criteria: ITI Fitter trade pass-out; age 16–25; Maharashtra domicile

name: MSBTE Diploma Internship Program — IT & Computer Science
department: Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education (MSBTE)
description: Structured internship for final-year diploma students in IT and Computer Science streams with industry partners across Maharashtra.
eligibility_criteria: Final-year diploma (IT/CS) student at MSBTE-affiliated polytechnic

name: MSRLM Rural Livelihood — Digital Literacy Training
description: Free digital literacy and basic IT training for rural youth to support employment in data entry, digital marketing, and BPO sectors.
eligibility_criteria: Maharashtra rural domicile; age 18–35; 10th pass minimum

name: DVET Electrician Trade Apprenticeship — Nashik District
department: Directorate of Vocational Education & Training, Maharashtra
description: Apprenticeship placements for ITI Electrician trade pass-outs with registered establishments in Nashik industrial area.
eligibility_criteria: ITI Electrician trade pass-out; age 16–25; Maharashtra domicile

name: MAHASWAYAM Employment Registration & Placement
description: State employment exchange registration and placement assistance connecting job seekers with verified employer vacancies across Maharashtra.
eligibility_criteria: Maharashtra domicile; any education level; registered on MAHASWAYAM portal

name: CMEGP — Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme
description: Subsidized entrepreneurship support for youth to set up micro-enterprises with bank loan subsidy (15–35% of project cost based on category).
eligibility_criteria: Maharashtra domicile; age 18–45; 8th pass minimum; project cost up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹25 lakh (service)

name: AICTE-NEAT Skill Enhancement Courses
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Free or subsidized online skill courses from EdTech partners through the NEAT (National Educational Alliance for Technology) portal for technical students.
eligibility_criteria: Students enrolled in AICTE-approved institutions; valid student ID

name: MSSDS Short-Term Skill Training — Thane/Mumbai
description: Short-term (3–6 month) skill training programs aligned with NSQF in sectors like IT-ITeS, automotive, and healthcare for unemployed youth.
eligibility_criteria: Maharashtra domicile; age 18–35; 10th/12th pass depending on course; preference for BPL/EWS candidates
